title: Hard Knocks sheds light on why Cooper Kupp was never in danger of being a cap casualty

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Hard Knocks sheds light on why Cooper Kupp was never in danger of being a cap casualty
sources.description: Many Seahawks fans thought the team would move on from Kupp after winning the Super Bowl in order to save cap space, and Hard Knocks shows why that was never on the table.
